clips.title: The story
paras: Magis Sparkmantle is a gnome mage trainer stationed inside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. He offers guidance and training to fledgling spellcasters who venture out from Coldridge Valley into the heart of Dun Morogh.

While dwarves gather in the Thunderbrew Distillery for hearty ales, Magis Sparkmantle provides an arcane presence among the casks and kegs of Kharanos. Gnome mages often integrate closely with their dwarven allies across Dun Morogh, and Sparkmantle serves as a key mentor for novice spellcasters ready to expand their theoretical and practical grasp of the arcane arts.

Beyond instructing novices in basic incantations, Magis ensures that promising students connect with broader magical circles. When mages outgrow early local instruction or require specialized guidance, Sparkmantle directs them further afield, sending them toward fellow practitioners like Bink or mentors stationed across the Alliance's primary hubs.
